name: Polearm Master
summary: A reach-weapon specialist who controls adjacent space, flanks flexibly, and protects allies with a readied polearm.

features.name: Pole Fighting -4
features.summary: As an immediate action, shorten a reach spear or polearm to attack adjacent targets at -4 until you restore your grip.

features.name: Pole Fighting
features.summary: Use the shortened grip without an attack penalty.

features.name: Steadfast Pike +1
features.summary: Gain +1 on readied attacks and attacks of opportunity with spears and polearms.

features.name: Polearm Training +1
features.summary: Gain +1 on attack and damage rolls with spears and polearms.

features.name: Flexible Flanker
features.summary: Choose any adjacent square as your location when determining flanking.

features.name: Sweeping Fend
features.summary: Use a spear or polearm for bull rush and trip attempts at -4 CMB; trip weapons avoid the trip penalty.

features.name: Step Aside
features.summary: When a threatened creature steps adjacent, immediately step away and gain +2 dodge AC against it until your next turn.

features.name: Polearm Parry
features.summary: Immediately grant an ally threatened by your attacker +2 shield AC and DR 5/— against one melee attack.

featureOverrides.summary: Master one type of spear or polearm and improve its critical performance.
